headline: President Clinton extended the life of an advisory committee that studies illnesses reported by Gulf War veterans.
what_it_does: This order kept the Presidential Advisory Committee on Gulf War Veterans' Illnesses running past its original end date. The committee looks into health problems reported by people who served in the 1991 Gulf War and gives advice to the President. The title does not say how long the extension lasts or whether the committee's duties changed.

who_it_affects.how: The committee studying their reported illnesses continued its work for a longer period.

who_it_affects.group: Members and staff of the advisory committee
who_it_affects.how: They continued serving on the committee instead of having it end on schedule.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 30, 1997; the length of the extension is not stated in the title.
